title: Value-addition of carbohydrate-derived platform molecules using stoichiometric redox reagents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28739-28753
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04323A, Review Article
Open Access

Saikat Dutta
The carbohydrate-derived platform chemicals can be transformed into fine chemicals using stoichiometric redox reagents (SRRs). The sustainability parameters and process economics involving SRRs are comparable with catalytic processes in many cases.
